verdict.rationale: Ramp documents issuing instant virtual cards with per-vendor spending limits, so per-card limits are a first-party capability. The evidence does not show limits or granular controls assigned to each employee. The 'per agent, per task, per merchant' restrictions apply to AI agents, not employees, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: documented per-employee card limit configuration, granular employee-level controls (merchant/category restrictions, time windows), independent or hands-on corroboration of limit-setting.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set per-card spend limits and granular controls for each employee

citations.quote: A finance team issues instant virtual cards for each software subscription with per-vendor spending limits
